title: Task Master
description: This Minecraft challenge mod implements a forced rotation system where multiple participants share a single character and inventory, cycling control every minute!                                    https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gTgrHPax0hk
body: This Minecraft challenge mod implements a forced rotation system where multiple participants share a single character and inventory, cycling control every minute. The core mechanic revolves around hidden, individualized objectives that each person must complete while operating under the same shared game state. Because the players are unaware of each other's specific tasks, the gameplay relies on strategic deception, resource sabotage, and environmental manipulation to obstruct opponents from making progress, creating a highly competitive atmosphere where cooperation is often sacrificed to ensure personal victory.
